title: General Restoration Checks
source: Universal Master Restoration Task Catalog — 2026-10-23 private planning draft
disclaimer: Universal planning checklist for passenger cars, pickups and other vehicles. Some checks apply only to equipped body styles or systems. Mark not applicable where appropriate; verify model-specific factory instructions and safe procedures before any work.

tasks.title: Define target finish and use
tasks.requirements: Inspection notes; owner decisions; milestone template
tasks.outcome: Choose driver-grade, original, custom, or show objectives separately for each vehicle

tasks.title: Confirm ownership, title and vehicle identification
tasks.requirements: Titles, VIN/body/frame identifier references, photographs retained privately
tasks.outcome: Verify lawful identity and paperwork before investment or publication

tasks.title: Identify vehicle and donor component years
tasks.requirements: Service manuals, casting numbers, tags and measurements
tasks.outcome: Identify the actual passenger-car body shell or pickup cab, chassis/frame, engine, axles and donor parts before selecting repair procedures.

tasks.title: Record existing modifications
tasks.requirements: Photos, measurements and component list
tasks.outcome: Identify what is changed so stock procedures are not blindly applied

tasks.title: Build baseline photo and condition inventory
tasks.requirements: Camera, measurement reference, notes
tasks.outcome: Capture current condition of all systems before dismantling

tasks.title: Create parts and hardware inventory
tasks.requirements: Bins, labels, existing parts photographs
tasks.outcome: Track have/missing/condition for each assembly

tasks.title: Select factory and professional source references
tasks.requirements: Applicable shop and body manuals, component instructions
tasks.outcome: Link each major repair to verified year/part applicable evidence

tasks.title: Prioritize safety, reliability and finish
tasks.requirements: Triage matrix and inspection findings
tasks.outcome: Make roadworthiness gates mandatory and cosmetic tasks owner-selectable

tasks.title: Plan costs, tool reuse and repair-versus-replace
tasks.requirements: Budget categories, supplier and tool list
tasks.outcome: Separate estimated costs, purchases, shared tools and outsourced services

tasks.title: Define job verification and documentation
tasks.requirements: Checklist, measurements, photos and tests
tasks.outcome: Record completion evidence and lessons; avoid assuming completed from a photo

tasks.title: Establish safe lifting and support
tasks.requirements: Rated hoist/jacks/stands, wheel chocks, firm floor, PPE
tasks.outcome: Stabilize vehicle and body before any inspection beneath

tasks.title: Assess old coatings and environmental hazards
tasks.requirements: Coating hazard assessment, ventilation, suitable protection
tasks.outcome: Select controlled methods for old paint, dust, sealants and fluids

tasks.title: Prepare fire protection and welding area
tasks.requirements: Appropriate extinguisher, welding blankets, ventilation, PPE
tasks.outcome: Separate ignition sources from fuel, wiring and interiors

tasks.title: Drain or contain fluids when necessary
tasks.requirements: Drain pans, absorbents, labeled containers
tasks.outcome: Capture fluids safely before component removal

tasks.title: Plan disassembly sequence
tasks.requirements: Factory procedures, photos, task dependencies
tasks.outcome: Avoid removing structural supports without bracing

tasks.title: Label wiring, hoses and linkages
tasks.requirements: Tape labels, tags, reference photos
tasks.outcome: Record routing, location and connection orientation

tasks.title: Bag and index removed hardware
tasks.requirements: Bags, bins, labels and hardware map
tasks.outcome: Preserve hardware identity and note missing or unusable fasteners

tasks.title: Clean reusable components for inspection
tasks.requirements: Safe cleaners, brushes, PPE and trays
tasks.outcome: Remove grime without hiding damage or harming parts

tasks.title: Provide weather and debris protection
tasks.requirements: Covers, masking, shelving and dry storage
tasks.outcome: Prevent deterioration during long restoration pauses

categories.title: Chassis, body shell and structural mounting

tasks.title: Survey frame rails or unibody structure
tasks.requirements: Lighting, straightedge, lift access, measurements
tasks.outcome: Inspect rust, distortions, collision repairs and load-bearing areas

tasks.title: Measure chassis/body alignment
tasks.requirements: Factory datum diagrams and measuring equipment
tasks.outcome: Compare critical diagonals and mounting points before structural work

tasks.title: Inspect chassis/unibody crossmembers and attachments
tasks.requirements: Applicable frame or unibody diagrams, light, inspection tools and mounting references
tasks.outcome: Identify cracks, corrosion, failed welds or loose fasteners at load-bearing members and attachments.

tasks.title: Inspect body mounts or structural attachment points
tasks.requirements: Factory body/chassis diagrams, light, mirror and corrosion-inspection tools
tasks.outcome: Check separate-frame body/cab mount metal and hardware or the applicable unibody structural attachment points.

tasks.title: Verify and secure body-to-frame mounts (where fitted)
tasks.requirements: Correct factory body/cab mounting bolts, isolators, sleeves, washers, supports and torque specifications where applicable
tasks.outcome: For body-on-frame vehicles, check and secure all required body/cab mounts. For integral unibody vehicles without separate mounts, mark not applicable and inspect structural joints instead.

tasks.title: Verify body/chassis geometry and panel alignment
tasks.requirements: Applicable body datum diagrams, measuring tools, and mounting support or shims where specified
tasks.outcome: Measure critical body openings, door gaps, controls and structural alignment; adjust body-to-frame position only where vehicle design permits.

tasks.title: Inspect passenger-compartment floors and seat anchors
tasks.requirements: Work light, underside access, measuring tools and repair materials only if damage is found
tasks.outcome: Check floors, footwells, seat attachment points and supporting metal for corrosion, weakness or previous repairs.

tasks.title: Inspect cowl, firewall and upper pillars
tasks.requirements: Light, mirror, drainage and rust tools
tasks.outcome: Check for leaks, prior repairs, weakened seams and steering passage condition

tasks.title: Inspect roof supports and header structure
tasks.requirements: Light, mirror and dimension references
tasks.outcome: Separate surface roof rust from support/header damage

tasks.title: Plan structural bracing before cutting
tasks.requirements: Datum plan, bracing steel, qualified welding plan
tasks.outcome: Maintain opening/diagonal geometry when removing load-bearing panels

tasks.title: Inspect unibody rails, torque boxes and rockers (if applicable)
tasks.requirements: Factory unibody dimensions, supported chassis, structural measurement tools
tasks.outcome: For unibody cars, inspect rails, torque boxes, rockers and integral load-bearing body structure; not a separate-frame inspection.

tasks.title: Inspect front suspension anchors and crossmembers
tasks.requirements: Factory suspension references, rated support equipment and inspection tools
tasks.outcome: Inspect front spring hangers, steering/suspension attachment points, K-members or front crossmembers as fitted.

tasks.title: Inspect rear suspension and axle attachment points
tasks.requirements: Lighting, alignment references and torque tools
tasks.outcome: Check applicable spring/shock/control-arm attachments for cracks, corrosion, damage or loose mounts.

tasks.title: Inspect cargo-area structural supports (bed or trunk)
tasks.requirements: Cargo floor/bed or trunk references, light, fastener tools where fitted
tasks.outcome: Confirm pickup bed attachments or trunk/cargo floor supports are sound before carrying cargo.

tasks.title: Assess donor body/chassis and mixed-year adaptations
tasks.requirements: Actual body shell or cab, chassis and donor component identification, measurements and qualified fitment references
tasks.outcome: Verify custom or mixed-year body, frame, steering/control and mounting clearances before permanent assembly or fabrication.

categories.title: Rust survey, structural sheet metal and fabrication

tasks.title: Map all visible rust and previous repairs
tasks.requirements: Inspection light, scraper, photographs and notes
tasks.outcome: Record surface rust, heavy pitting, thinning, perforation separately

tasks.title: Inspect roof rust and coating failure
tasks.requirements: Inspection tools, safe cleaning/abrasives, coating PPE
tasks.outcome: Determine whether roof needs treatment or sound-metal patching

tasks.title: Inspect rear window aperture and flange
tasks.requirements: Light, mirror, cleaning tools, gasket references
tasks.outcome: Confirm metal integrity and retaining geometry before rear glass

tasks.title: Inspect windshield aperture and header
tasks.requirements: Light, sealing-flange reference, safe prep tools
tasks.outcome: Verify metal soundness before gasket/glass installation

tasks.title: Inspect rear body corners and passenger-compartment bulkhead
tasks.requirements: Lighting, access tools, mirror and careful seam inspection
tasks.outcome: Check pickup cab corners/rear cab wall or passenger-car rear body corners/bulkhead and lower seams, as applicable.

tasks.title: Inspect rockers, sills and lower pillars
tasks.requirements: Body diagrams, measurement and inspection tools
tasks.outcome: Check load path, drains and inner/outer rust

tasks.title: Inspect floor pans and lower firewall
tasks.requirements: Light, underside access, fitment patterns
tasks.outcome: Identify affected sections and adjacent supports

tasks.title: Inspect door skins and bottoms
tasks.requirements: Trim tools, mirror and cleaning supplies
tasks.outcome: Inspect internal drains, seam rust and weakened metal

tasks.title: Inspect front fenders and inner aprons
tasks.requirements: Wheel-access tools, light and section references
tasks.outcome: Locate trapped dirt, rust and mount damage

tasks.title: Inspect rear outer panels and wheelhouses
tasks.requirements: Access to wheelhouses, quarter panels or pickup bedsides; light and rust-inspection tools
tasks.outcome: Locate corrosion and perforation in the rear wheelhouses and surrounding quarter panels or bedsides.

tasks.title: Inspect cowl drains and plenum
tasks.requirements: Drain access/cleaning, mirror, appropriate PPE
tasks.outcome: Determine leaks and corrosion source before patches

tasks.title: Inspect drip rails, seams and gutters
tasks.requirements: Light, safe coating-removal materials, seam references
tasks.outcome: Distinguish cosmetic rust from perforated seams

tasks.title: Decide repair sections and metal gauge
tasks.requirements: Cut lines, templates, measured actual thickness and supplier fitment
tasks.outcome: Use sound steel and correct shape; no filler over perforation

tasks.title: Prepare welding coupons and verify setup
tasks.requirements: Matching steel, welder, wire/gas, PPE and practice pieces
tasks.outcome: Confirm weld quality off-vehicle before repair welding

tasks.title: Fabricate and weld required patches
tasks.requirements: Templates, clamps, sheet steel, welding tools and PPE as justified
tasks.outcome: Cut only compromised sections and verify fit/alignment

tasks.title: Protect completed repairs and cavities
tasks.requirements: Compatible primer, seam sealer, cavity protection and PPE
tasks.outcome: Seal moisture paths and protect inaccessible backs of repaired seams

categories.title: Cargo area: pickup bed, trunk and rear closures

tasks.title: Inspect cargo floor (pickup bed or trunk)
tasks.requirements: Light, safe underside access, straightedge and rust assessment tools
tasks.outcome: Identify surface corrosion, perforation and weak floor/support metal in the vehicle's cargo area.

tasks.title: Assess rear wheel-arch and outer body-panel rust
tasks.requirements: Inspection tools, repair templates and sheet metal only if needed
tasks.outcome: Map rust at rear wheel openings, inner wheelhouses, pickup bedsides or passenger-car quarter panels.

tasks.title: Inspect cargo-floor crossmembers and supports
tasks.requirements: Underside access, light, mounting tools
tasks.outcome: Check load-carrying bed or trunk floor structures, seams and support attachments.

tasks.title: Inspect pickup bed-to-frame hardware (pickups only)
tasks.requirements: Correct pickup bed fasteners, spacers/pads and applicable torque references
tasks.outcome: On a pickup, verify the cargo bed is securely attached to its chassis; mark not applicable on a vehicle without a separate pickup bed.

tasks.title: Inspect pickup bed front wall and corners (pickups only)
tasks.requirements: For pickups: straightedge, light and rust-inspection tools
tasks.outcome: Check pickup bed panel strength, seams and clearance to the passenger cab; not a trunk-floor check.

tasks.title: Inspect pickup bed stake pockets and seams (if fitted)
tasks.requirements: For beds with stake pockets: light, mirror and cleaning tools
tasks.outcome: On equipped pickups, inspect water-trapping stake pockets and their body/bed attachment seams.

tasks.title: Inspect tailgate or trunk/decklid hinges and latches
tasks.requirements: Vehicle-specific hinges, latch/striker, pivots, supports, cables/chains where fitted and adjustment tools
tasks.outcome: Confirm the tailgate or trunk lid opens safely, closes securely and retains cargo as designed.

tasks.title: Align cargo box, tailgate or trunk/decklid
tasks.requirements: Body alignment references, hinge and latch adjustments, fasteners and measuring tools
tasks.outcome: Verify pickup bed/closure or passenger-car trunk lid panel alignment, clearance and latch engagement.

tasks.title: Inspect wiring, fuel and exhaust routing below cargo floor
tasks.requirements: Light, retaining clips, heat protection and correct mounts
tasks.outcome: Protect wiring and plumbing beneath the pickup bed or passenger-car trunk/cargo floor from abrasion and heat.

tasks.title: Inspect cargo tie-downs or load anchors (where fitted)
tasks.requirements: Verified attachment hardware and sound panel backing
tasks.outcome: On equipped vehicles, verify anchor backing metal and retention hardware before carrying secured loads.

tasks.title: Inspect trunk wells, drop-offs and extensions (if equipped)
tasks.requirements: Trunk/cargo well and underside access, inspection and patch tools if required
tasks.outcome: Inspect trunk well seams, lower quarter-panel extensions and water-entry areas when present.

tasks.title: Assess optional cargo-area floor coating or liner
tasks.requirements: Compatible coating products and surface prep if chosen
tasks.outcome: Choose optional bedliner or trunk/cargo-floor protection after necessary structural and corrosion repairs.

tasks.title: Identify installed engine and accessory setup
tasks.requirements: Casting/ID references, manuals and photos
tasks.outcome: Verify actual engine, mount and accessory compatibility

tasks.title: Confirm engine starts, runs and idles
tasks.requirements: Safe fuel/ignition setup, tachometer and leak observation
tasks.outcome: Record actual starting, idle and warm-up behavior

tasks.title: Inspect external engine leaks and fasteners
tasks.requirements: Light, cleaning supplies, torque references
tasks.outcome: Find oil, fuel and coolant leaks and loose mounts

tasks.title: Check oil quality, pressure and circulation
tasks.requirements: Correct oil/filter, pressure gauge and manuals
tasks.outcome: Verify oil pressure at appropriate temperatures before use

tasks.title: Evaluate compression or leak-down if indicated
tasks.requirements: Compression/leakdown tools and battery support
tasks.outcome: Test internal condition if symptoms justify teardown

tasks.title: Inspect distributor, cap, rotor, plug wires
tasks.requirements: Ignition tools, replacement components only if worn
tasks.outcome: Check spark quality, condition and correct routing

tasks.title: Inspect spark plugs and firing order
tasks.requirements: Correct plugs, socket and factory firing-order diagram
tasks.outcome: Verify gap, heat range and cylinder lead orientation

tasks.title: Verify base timing and advance operation
tasks.requirements: Timing light, vacuum tools and exact engine specs
tasks.outcome: Correct engine timing using applicable distributor setup

tasks.title: Inspect PCV, breather and vacuum system
tasks.requirements: Hoses, PCV valve, clamps and vacuum diagram
tasks.outcome: Eliminate vacuum leaks and crankcase restrictions

tasks.title: Inspect engine mounts and brackets
tasks.requirements: Mount inspection, lifting/support tools, bolts if needed
tasks.outcome: Confirm powertrain retention, fan and driveline clearance

tasks.title: Inspect throttle linkage and return springs
tasks.requirements: Hand tools, return springs, linkage reference
tasks.outcome: Verify throttle cannot stick and returns reliably

tasks.title: Change engine service consumables when warranted
tasks.requirements: Correct oil, filter, belts, plugs and gasket supplies
tasks.outcome: Establish reliable maintenance baseline without unnecessary teardown

tasks.title: Decide whether full engine rebuild is warranted
tasks.requirements: Performance tests and symptom log, machine-shop estimate if necessary
tasks.outcome: Skip overhaul if the existing engine proves serviceable for owner goals

tasks.title: Inspect fuel tank exterior and mounts
tasks.requirements: Lift access, straps, fasteners, safety PPE
tasks.outcome: Check rust, leaks, damage and secure retention

tasks.title: Inspect tank interior and fuel cleanliness
tasks.requirements: Safe tank-handling gear, approved inspection method
tasks.outcome: Decide clean/repair/replace based on actual contamination

tasks.title: Verify filler neck, cap and venting
tasks.requirements: Hoses, cap, sealing parts and model-specific diagrams
tasks.outcome: Restore safe filling and venting with no leaks

tasks.title: Inspect fuel sender and gauge operation
tasks.requirements: Meter, sender gasket and wiring diagram
tasks.outcome: Confirm fuel level signal and sealed sender mounting

tasks.title: Inspect hard fuel lines and routing
tasks.requirements: Correct-rated line, flare tools and supports as required
tasks.outcome: Eliminate pinch points, rust and exhaust contact

tasks.title: Replace unsafe flexible fuel hose/clamps
tasks.requirements: Correct fuel-rated hose and compatible clamps
tasks.outcome: Avoid degraded or mismatched hose and fuel leaks

tasks.title: Inspect fuel pump operation and connections
tasks.requirements: Pressure test gauge, filter and fittings as needed
tasks.outcome: Verify safe supply and absence of leaks

tasks.title: Inspect fuel filters and debris protection
tasks.requirements: Correct filter orientation and fittings
tasks.outcome: Keep contaminants out of pump/carb without unsafe restrictions

tasks.title: Inspect carburetor/injection and choke
tasks.requirements: Rebuild components or gasket set if indicated, tune tools
tasks.outcome: Verify starting, idle, acceleration and no fuel drips

tasks.title: Inspect air cleaner and intake sealing
tasks.requirements: Correct filter, housing seal, hose routing
tasks.outcome: Prevent dust ingestion and wrong crankcase ventilation

tasks.title: Perform static and running fuel leak checks
tasks.requirements: Absorbents, safe extinguisher, inspection light
tasks.outcome: Confirm no leaks before driving or welding

tasks.title: Evaluate relocating a vehicle fuel tank (if planned)
tasks.requirements: Compatible tank and mounts, safe chassis/unibody and cargo-floor clearances, filler, vent, sender, protection and fuel plumbing
tasks.outcome: Only if a relocation is planned, verify mounting, suspension travel, impact/exhaust/driveline clearance, vent/filler routing and leak integrity before use.

tasks.title: Evaluate E85 conversion for a carbureted engine (if planned)
tasks.requirements: Actual carburetor ID, ethanol-rated tank, lines, hoses, seals, pump, filter, flow capacity, tuning requirements and legal/operational feasibility
tasks.outcome: Only if E85 use is being considered, investigate fuel compatibility, tuning, storage, weather operation, fuel-system capacity and road-use requirements before buying parts.

tasks.title: Inspect radiator and mounting
tasks.requirements: Radiator inspection, hoses/mount hardware if required
tasks.outcome: Check core corrosion, leaks, fan clearance and support

tasks.title: Inspect coolant hoses and clamps
tasks.requirements: Correct hose bends, clamps, coolant capture
tasks.outcome: Replace weak or incorrectly routed hoses

tasks.title: Inspect water pump and front drive
tasks.requirements: Leak/shaft inspection, belts and gasket only as indicated
tasks.outcome: Verify proper circulation and no bearing play

tasks.title: Test thermostat and radiator cap
tasks.requirements: Correct-rated cap, thermostat and coolant-safe tools
tasks.outcome: Confirm pressure and temperature regulation

tasks.title: Inspect fan, clutch and shroud
tasks.requirements: Fasteners, blade/guard inspection, correct shroud
tasks.outcome: Verify safe fan retention and airflow

tasks.title: Inspect belts, pulleys and accessory alignment
tasks.requirements: Belts, straightedge, adjustment tools
tasks.outcome: Correct slipping, misalignment or fraying

tasks.title: Flush/refill cooling system when needed
tasks.requirements: Appropriate coolant, water, flush method, drain gear
tasks.outcome: Remove contamination and bleed/verify coolant level

tasks.title: Verify operating temperature at idle/load
tasks.requirements: Thermometer, gauge checks and leak monitoring
tasks.outcome: Confirm safe temperature rise and recovery

tasks.title: Inspect heater core plumbing and shutoff
tasks.requirements: Heater hoses, clamps and possible heater core
tasks.outcome: Fix cooling circuit leaks and maintain defrost path

tasks.title: Inspect exhaust manifolds and gaskets
tasks.requirements: Fastener tools, gaskets if leaking and heat protection
tasks.outcome: Check leaks/cracks and secure exhaust mounting

tasks.title: Inspect exhaust pipe, muffler and hangers
tasks.requirements: Correct pipe, clamps/hangers and lift access
tasks.outcome: Route exhaust gases safely away from the passenger compartment and fuel system.

tasks.title: Inspect heat shielding and clearance
tasks.requirements: Shielding, hanger hardware, light
tasks.outcome: Protect brake/fuel lines, cargo floor and nearby body/chassis components from exhaust heat.

tasks.title: Identify transmission, drive axles and transfer case (if fitted)
tasks.requirements: ID tags, manuals and photos
tasks.outcome: Document actual engine-to-axle driveline and any transfer case; do not assume all vehicles have four-wheel drive.

tasks.title: Inspect transmission mounts and crossmember
tasks.requirements: Mount pads, bolts, torque tools
tasks.outcome: Check secure retention and driveline angle

tasks.title: Service transmission fluid and leaks as needed
tasks.requirements: Correct fluid, filters/gaskets as applicable, pan tools
tasks.outcome: Check level, condition and signs of internal wear

tasks.title: Verify shift linkage, indicator and neutral safety
tasks.requirements: Linkage bushings, wiring diagram and adjustment tools
tasks.outcome: Confirm selected gear and interlocks match control position

tasks.title: Confirm transmission engages and shifts correctly
tasks.requirements: Safe stands/test plan and operating checks
tasks.outcome: Record shift behavior but do not treat engagement alone as full health

tasks.title: Inspect clutch, linkage and pedal if manual
tasks.requirements: Cable/rod/hydraulic parts as applicable, adjustment tools
tasks.outcome: Test release, clutch engagement and no interference

tasks.title: Inspect converter, flexplate and starter mesh if automatic
tasks.requirements: Correct fasteners, access tools and spec reference
tasks.outcome: Address noises, damage and secure coupling

tasks.title: Inspect transfer case, mounts and seals (4WD only)
tasks.requirements: Applicable fluid, seals and mounts if required
tasks.outcome: Verify case securely mounted and serviceable

tasks.title: Verify transfer-case range selection (4WD only)
tasks.requirements: Shift linkage tools, owner manual, safe function check
tasks.outcome: Differentiate lever movement from actual high/low engagement

tasks.title: Inspect 4WD front hubs and axle disconnects (if fitted)
tasks.requirements: Hub service kit, grease and hand tools as applicable
tasks.outcome: Verify both front wheel drive paths engage where designed

tasks.title: Inspect front driveshaft and joints (if fitted)
tasks.requirements: Joint inspection, replacement joints, proper tools
tasks.outcome: Check play, alignment and clearance through articulation

tasks.title: Inspect rear driveshaft and universal joints
tasks.requirements: Joint service tools, grease and fasteners
tasks.outcome: Correct play, vibration and unsafe retainers

tasks.title: Inspect differentials, housings and axle seals
tasks.requirements: Correct fluid, seals and lift access
tasks.outcome: Assess noise, leaks and bearing condition

tasks.title: Verify front/rear axle ratio match (4WD only)
tasks.requirements: Differential tags/rotation count with controlled procedure
tasks.outcome: Prevent driveline bind on 4x4 configurations

tasks.title: Inspect axle wheel bearings and hub retention
tasks.requirements: Bearing tools, seals, torque and preload procedures
tasks.outcome: Restore correct bearing condition and adjustments

tasks.title: Perform safe driveline and 4WD checks (as applicable)
tasks.requirements: Controlled test area, correct engagement instructions
tasks.outcome: Verify safe driveline function on every vehicle, plus transfer-case and 4WD operation only if fitted.

tasks.title: Inspect steering column and steering-shaft connection
tasks.requirements: Correct couplers, fasteners, column support, inspection light
tasks.outcome: Verify wheel input safely reaches steering gear without binding

tasks.title: Inspect steering gear mounting and leakage
tasks.requirements: Gear fastener/spec references and access tools
tasks.outcome: Ensure box anchored to sound frame and no excessive play

tasks.title: Inspect power-steering pump, hoses and belt if fitted
tasks.requirements: Correct hoses, fluid and fittings as applicable
tasks.outcome: Restore safe assist and check leaks

tasks.title: Inspect tie rods, drag link and linkage
tasks.requirements: Joint inspection and replacement parts only if worn
tasks.outcome: Eliminate dangerous looseness in steering links

tasks.title: Inspect kingpins or ball joints as applicable
tasks.requirements: Correct type-specific inspection tools and wear limits
tasks.outcome: Verify pivot wear without guessing axle variant

tasks.title: Inspect steering stops and steering clearances
tasks.requirements: Full-lock checks, lift support and clearance reference
tasks.outcome: Prevent tire, hose or shaft interference

tasks.title: Inspect leaf springs and coils as fitted
tasks.requirements: Spring inspection, rated supports and mount tools
tasks.outcome: Find cracked leaves, sagging or broken coils

tasks.title: Inspect spring bushings, shackles and hangers
tasks.requirements: Bushings/hardware if worn, torque references
tasks.outcome: Check attachment integrity and movement

tasks.title: Inspect suspension control arms and pivots
tasks.requirements: Appropriate tools, bushings and ball-joint reference
tasks.outcome: Verify true installed geometry for each model

tasks.title: Inspect shocks and shock mounts
tasks.requirements: Replacement shocks/hardware as indicated
tasks.outcome: Find leaks, broken mounts and failed damping

tasks.title: Inspect sway bars, links and bump stops if fitted
tasks.requirements: Bushings, brackets and fasteners if damaged
tasks.outcome: Verify components don't bind or detach

tasks.title: Inspect solid front axle mounts and U-bolts (if fitted)
tasks.requirements: Axle alignment reference, U-bolt safety and torque procedures
tasks.outcome: Confirm retention of solid axle where fitted

tasks.title: Measure ride height, alignment and tracking
tasks.requirements: Alignment equipment or qualified alignment service
tasks.outcome: Set correct alignment after steering/suspension repairs

tasks.title: Perform steering articulation and clearance tests
tasks.requirements: Jack support, helper, inspection tools
tasks.outcome: Verify steering controls don't contact the body shell/cab, chassis or fuel and brake lines at full travel.

tasks.title: Inspect brake pedal, pivot and mounting
tasks.requirements: Pedal tools, pivot bushings and bracket access
tasks.outcome: Confirm pedal returns and mounting metal is sound

tasks.title: Inspect master cylinder and reservoir
tasks.requirements: Correct fluid, bench/line procedure if replacement needed
tasks.outcome: Check leaks, contamination and proper function

tasks.title: Inspect brake booster and vacuum supply if present
tasks.requirements: Vacuum gauges and hose/booster reference
tasks.outcome: Verify assist without leaks or unexpected pedal behavior

tasks.title: Inspect rigid brake lines and fittings
tasks.requirements: Correct brake tubing, fittings, flare tools if required
tasks.outcome: Check corrosion and routing with no leakage

tasks.title: Inspect flexible brake hoses and routing
tasks.requirements: Correct rated hoses, clips, brake fluid
tasks.outcome: Replace cracked lines and verify full suspension travel

tasks.title: Inspect wheel cylinders or brake calipers
tasks.requirements: Seal/slide inspection and repair kits if indicated
tasks.outcome: Confirm no leakage, seizure or uneven movement

tasks.title: Inspect discs/rotors and drums
tasks.requirements: Measuring tools, service limits and replacements if needed
tasks.outcome: Verify usable thickness and condition

tasks.title: Inspect pads/shoes, springs and hardware
tasks.requirements: Friction kit and brake hardware as needed
tasks.outcome: Verify wear and correct reassembly

tasks.title: Inspect adjustment and self-adjusting mechanisms
tasks.requirements: Correct parts and adjustment tools
tasks.outcome: Set proper drum adjustment and operation where applicable

tasks.title: Inspect parking brake cables, levers and anchors
tasks.requirements: Cables, brackets and adjustment tools as indicated
tasks.outcome: Restore independent vehicle holding function

tasks.title: Inspect hydraulic distribution/proportioning components
tasks.requirements: Hydraulic diagrams and leak inspection
tasks.outcome: Confirm intact circuits and warning function

tasks.title: Bleed and pressure-check brake system
tasks.requirements: Correct brake fluid, bleeding gear and inspection helper
tasks.outcome: Remove air and verify sustained hydraulic pressure with no leakage

tasks.title: Verify stopping, pull, pedal feel and parking hold
tasks.requirements: Controlled testing and qualified assessment if needed
tasks.outcome: Do not infer roadworthiness merely because the vehicle stopped once

tasks.title: Identify correct wheel dimensions and load rating
tasks.requirements: Wheel specs, backspacing and load data
tasks.outcome: Verify match to hubs, brakes and intended vehicle load

tasks.title: Inspect wheel cracks, corrosion and seats
tasks.requirements: Inspection light, wheel service tools
tasks.outcome: Reject damaged or incorrect rim/lug seats

tasks.title: Inspect tire age, size, condition and load
tasks.requirements: DOT date, tread tools and manufacturer specs
tasks.outcome: Replace tires unsafe from age, dry rot or damage

tasks.title: Inspect valve stems and inflation retention
tasks.requirements: Valve tools and tire service as needed
tasks.outcome: Prevent slow leaks and tire failure

tasks.title: Verify studs, nuts and lug engagement
tasks.requirements: Correct lugs/studs, calibrated torque wrench
tasks.outcome: Check stud damage and proper wheel retention

tasks.title: Balance wheels and assess vibration
tasks.requirements: Wheel balancing service and inspection
tasks.outcome: Avoid shaking and abnormal tire wear

tasks.title: Verify spare tire, jack and lug tool
tasks.requirements: Spare, rated jack, holder and wrench
tasks.outcome: Ensure roadside wheel-change capability

tasks.title: Check tire-to-body/frame clearance throughout travel
tasks.requirements: Steering sweep, ride-height/load assessment
tasks.outcome: Avoid rubbing on brakes, springs or body edges

tasks.title: Inspect battery, hold-down and terminals
tasks.requirements: Correct battery, tray and fasteners as needed
tasks.outcome: Confirm secure mounting and reliable terminal connection

tasks.title: Inspect main cables, engine/frame grounds
tasks.requirements: Cable, straps, terminals and meter
tasks.outcome: Restore high-current continuity and avoid heat

tasks.title: Inspect starter and start interlock
tasks.requirements: Starter tests, wiring reference and meter
tasks.outcome: Verify safe cranking and neutral/clutch safety

tasks.title: Inspect alternator, regulator and charging
tasks.requirements: Meter, load test and belt reference
tasks.outcome: Confirm charging without overvoltage

tasks.title: Inspect ignition switch, coil feed and run circuits
tasks.requirements: Wiring diagrams, meter and connectors
tasks.outcome: Verify normal starting and shutdown

tasks.title: Inspect harness insulation, routing and repairs
